**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrentinOpen2022#19522-registration-registrazione).**

**IMPORTANT:** Please insert your size for the free T-shirt in the comment section of the registration.
